gold.goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM warehouse.main.companies
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.companies WHERE country = 'India' ORDER BY name
SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE m.metric = 'runway_months' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value < 6

SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE m.metric = 'runway_months' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value < 6 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warehouse.main.meeting_docs d WHERE d.company_id = c.company_id AND d.met_on >= DATE '2026-06-03')
SELECT sum(committed_usd) AS total FROM warehouse.main.funds
SELECT f.name, count(DISTINCT i.company_id) AS n FROM warehouse.main.funds f JOIN warehouse.main.investments i ON i.fund_id = f.fund_id GROUP BY f.name

SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.funding_rounds r ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.stage = 'series-b' AND r.announced_on >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND r.announced_on < DATE '2024-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.meeting_docs d ON d.company_id = c.company_id WHERE d.quarter = 'Q1' AND d.doc_type = 'board' AND regexp_matches(lower(d.raw_text), 'runway|cash out')

SELECT c.name, m.value AS arr_usd FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'fintech' AND m.metric = 'arr_usd' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30'

SELECT c.name, m.value AS arr_usd FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE m.metric = 'arr_usd' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' ORDER BY m.value DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT s.thesis_fit, count(*) AS n FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.sectors s ON s.sector = c.sector GROUP BY s.thesis_fit
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.people p ON p.company_id = c.company_id WHERE p.is_founder AND p.departed_on IS NOT NULL
SELECT avg(i.ownership_pct) AS avg_pct FROM warehouse.main.investments i JOIN warehouse.main.funds f ON f.fund_id = i.fund_id WHERE f.name = 'Yardstick Fund II'
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.companies WHERE status = 'written-off'
SELECT sum(proceeds_usd) AS total FROM warehouse.main.exits WHERE exited_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND exited_on < DATE '2026-01-01'
SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE m.metric = 'nrr_pct' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value < 90
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM warehouse.main.funding_rounds WHERE lead_investor = 'Thornfield Partners'

SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.sectors s ON s.sector = c.sector JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.thesis_fit = 'core' AND m.metric = 'headcount' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value > 50
SELECT c.name, v.post_money_usd FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.valuations v ON v.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.status = 'exited'
SELECT doc_type, count(*) AS n FROM warehouse.main.meeting_docs GROUP BY doc_type
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.companies WHERE is_reported = false
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.funding_rounds r ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.amount_usd > 25000000
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.companies WHERE founded_year < 2010
SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE m.metric = 'runway_months' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value > 60
SELECT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.exits e ON e.company_id = c.company_id WHERE e.exit_type = 'shutdown'
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.funds WHERE vintage_year < 2015
SELECT name FROM warehouse.main.companies WHERE sector = 'biotech' AND status = 'active'
SELECT median(m.value) AS median_arr FROM warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m WHERE m.metric = 'arr_usd' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30'
SELECT c.name, count(*) AS n FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.funding_rounds r ON r.company_id = c.company_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) >= 3

SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM warehouse.main.companies c JOIN warehouse.main.meeting_docs d ON d.company_id = c.company_id JOIN warehouse.main.metrics_normalized m ON m.company_id = c.company_id WHERE d.quarter = 'Q1' AND m.metric = 'burn_usd_month' AND m.as_of = DATE '2026-06-30' AND m.value > 80000
